```sql
with paid_methods as (
    select order_id, method
    from (
        select a.order_id,
               a.method,
               row_number() over (
                   partition by a.order_id, a.amount_minor
                   order by a.attempt_no, a.attempt_id
               ) as capture_rank
        from payment_attempts a
        join orders o on o.order_id = a.order_id
        join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
        where not a.is_test
          and not o.is_test
          and a.status = 'captured'
          and s.region_id = 'IN-TN'
    ) x
    where capture_rank = 1
    group by order_id, method
),
order_flags as (
    select o.order_id,
           pm.method,
           max(case when not p.is_accessory then 1 else 0 end) as has_phone,
           max(case when p.is_accessory then 1 else 0 end) as has_accessory
    from orders o
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    join paid_methods pm on pm.order_id = o.order_id
    join order_items i on i.order_id = o.order_id
    join products p on p.sku = i.sku
    where not o.is_test
      and o.status = 'paid'
      and s.region_id = 'IN-TN'
      and o.business_date between date '2026-08-01' and date '2026-08-31'
    group by o.order_id, pm.method
)
select method as key,
       cast(
           sum(case when has_phone = 1 and has_accessory = 1 then 1 else 0 end) * 1.0
           / nullif(sum(case when has_phone = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0)
           as decimal(38,12)
       ) as value
from order_flags
group by method
order by value desc, key asc
```
